excerpt: Training The Next Generation Our Mission The Investigative Reporting Workshop aims to hold the powerful accountable through in-depth, data-driven investigations. IRW pairs student and early-career journalists with experienced professionals on investigative, data and enterprise projects across a wide range of topics, including, most recently, police use of force, immigration, and health care, among others.
